question: Who among the following is the first Indian female football player to play in the Union of European Football Association (UEFA) Women's Champions League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manisha Kalyan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Kalyan** is the** first Indian female football** player to play in the **Union of European Football Association **(UEFA) women's Champions League.
 
• She played for **Gokulam Kerala FC** in the **2018-19 **season.
 
• Manisha Kalyan is a forward player and has represented India in various** international tournaments.**
 
• She has also played for the Indian Women's League teams like **Rising Student Club** and **Sethu FC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shanti Mallick** is a former Indian** women's football team** captain who represented India in the 1980s and early 1990s.

 
 
• She was one of the pioneers of women's football in India and played for teams like **Orissa and Bengal.**
 
 
 
• **Bala Devi** is a current Indian women's football team captain who has won many awards and accolades in her career.
 
 
• She has played for teams like** Manipur Police Sports Club** and** Rangers Women's FC** in **Scotland.**
 
 
 
• **Oinam Bembem Devi **is a former Indian women's football team captain who has represented India in various international tournaments.
 
 
• She has played for teams like** Eastern Sporting Union** and **Sethu FC **in the Indian Women's League.
